title: Large affine spaces of symplectic forms
summary: Let F be a field and V be a 2n-dimensional vector space over F. In a previous article, we have proved that if F has more than 2n-2 elements then the greatest possible dimension for an affine space of symplectic forms on V is n(n-1). Here, under the same cardinality assumption we study the spaces that have the critical dimension n(n-1).
